{{Top|leg}}
The '''Deodum polar pipeline''' was a pipeline on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] that supplied [[Water/Legends|water]] to the [[Royal Icqui Aquaria]], a large aquarium located in the [[Hirkenglade Prefecture]].<ref name="CCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref>
